invariant: A legacy internal return is an ordinary Message with reversed endpoints and inherited dotted arrow configuration. Its constraints and paint sample the actual live segment at the arrow ordinate. The spatial-left endpoint is segment.pos2; the spatial-right endpoint is segment.pos2 minus activation component width if active, otherwise segment.pos1. Deactivation belongs to the sender and occurs only for an owned activating message.
causal_divergence: Rust's separate Return painter starts at participant centers and applies only a boolean half-activation offset to a left target, losing nested depth and the right-side active edge. The Return spacing branch also omits the ordinary message live-segment width adjustment. After self-return lowering removes the crash, checker_live_stack_2/3 differ only at the delegated non-self answer by one/two activation half-widths. Fresh reversed-order delegation exposes the matching constraint-width defect. Java does not have a separate Return rendering path: CommandReturn adds an ordinary Message.
